_help: Quiz for Web3 Hall of Famers. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: Who published the Bitcoin whitepaper in 2008?
questions.explain: Satoshi published it in 2008 and launched Bitcoin in January 2009. Their real identity has never been confirmed.

questions.question: What was new about Ethereum, proposed by Vitalik Buterin?
options: A blockchain that runs programs (smart contracts), not just payments
A faster way to mine Bitcoin
questions.answer: A blockchain that runs programs (smart contracts), not just payments
questions.explain: Vitalik was 19 when he published the Ethereum whitepaper in 2013.

questions.question: What did Hayden Adams build with Uniswap?
options: A way to swap tokens without an order book
questions.answer: A way to swap tokens without an order book
questions.explain: Uniswap is an automated market maker: you swap against a pool of tokens instead of waiting for a buyer or seller.

questions.question: USDT and USDC are both...
questions.explain: Tether (run by Paolo Ardoino) issues USDT; Circle (run by Jeremy Allaire) issues USDC.

questions.question: What does an onchain investigator like ZachXBT do?
options: Traces stolen funds and exposes scams
questions.answer: Traces stolen funds and exposes scams
questions.explain: Every transaction on a public blockchain can be followed, which is how investigators track hacks and rug pulls.

questions.question: What is the lesson of FTX (2022) and Terra (2022)?
options: Famous founders and big promises do not remove risk
Stablecoins always stay at one dollar
Exchanges always keep your money safe
questions.answer: Famous founders and big promises do not remove risk
questions.explain: FTX collapsed in November 2022 and Terra and Luna in May 2022. Never put in more than you can afford to lose.
